question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Aroma
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aroma"** means a distinctive, typically pleasant smell. (खुशबू)

 
 
• **Example: **The **aroma** of freshly baked bread filled the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **"Stink"** refers to a strong, unpleasant smell. (दुर्गंध)
 
 
• **Example: **The garbage left outside had started to **stink.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Aroma'** is **'Stink'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Brazen** (बेहया): Bold and without shame.

 
 
• **Example:** He exhibited a brazen disregard for the rules.
 
 
 
• **Essence** (सार): The intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something.
 
 
• **Example: **Understanding the essence of the problem is crucial for solving it.
 
 
 
• **Scent** (सुगंध): A distinctive smell, especially one that is pleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The scent of jasmine filled the room.
